ko.title: 추수감사절 식탁 비용: 올해 명절 저녁 식사 물가가 의미하는 것

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: 매년 11월이면 주최자들은 똑같은 수학 문제에 직면합니다. 식탁에 앉은 모두를 먹이는 데 비용이 얼마나 들까 하는 것이죠.

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: 올해 많은 이들이 식료품 가격이 몇 년 전보다 여전히 완강하게 높은 상황에서 그 계산을 하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: 인플레이션은 정점에서 꺾였지만, 둔화가 곧 가격 하락을 의미하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: 대부분의 식품 가격은 더 높은 수준에서 자리를 잡았고, 쇼핑객들은 여전히 계산대에서 이를 체감하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: 이 가이드는 돈이 어디로 흘러가는지, 왜 특정 품목의 가격이 더 비싼지, 그리고 식사를 희생하지 않으면서 청구 금액을 줄이는 방법을 설명합니다.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: 매장이나 지역마다 수치는 다를 수 있으므로, 이를 가격 견적서가 아닌 계획을 위한 틀로 활용하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## 돈은 어디로 가는가

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: 전통적인 추수감사절 저녁 식사는 몇 가지 범주로 구성됩니다.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: 그중 일부가 전체 비용의 대부분을 차지합니다.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **메인 요리.** 칠면조는 보통 가장 큰 비중을 차지하는 품목이며, 특히 대규모 모임일수록 그렇습니다. 가격은 크기, 브랜드, 그리고 칠면조가 신선한지, 냉동인지, 유기농인지, 방목형인지에 따라 달라집니다.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **유제품 및 제빵 재료.** 버터, 크림, 달걀, 우유는 거의 모든 사이드 디시와 디저트에 들어갑니다. 특히 버터와 달걀은 가격 변동이 심하기로 유명합니다.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **농산물.** 감자, 고구마, 그린빈, 크랜베리, 양파, 셀러리는 개별적으로는 저렴하지만, 많은 사람을 위해 요리할 때는 합산 금액이 커집니다.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **기본 식료품.** 밀가루, 설탕, 스터핑 믹스, 통조림 호박, 육수, 향신료는 카트를 가득 채우고 통로에 서 있기 전까지는 간과하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **음료 및 기타.** 롤빵, 음료, 애피타이저는 조용히 전체 비용을 예상보다 높게 밀어 올릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## 칠면조 가격이 급등하는 이유

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: 칠면조 비용은 식료품점보다 훨씬 앞선 단계의 요인들에 의해 결정됩니다.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: 동물 질병이 발생하면 사육 규모가 줄어들고 공급이 타이트해질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: 사료 비용, 인건비, 가공비 모두 도매 가격에 반영됩니다.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: 소매업체들은 또한 명절 몇 주 전 칠면조를 "손실 유도 상품(loss leader)"으로 사용하여, 쇼핑객을 매장으로 끌어들이기 위해 할인 판매하고 다른 품목에서 차액을 보전하기도 합니다.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: 같은 마을 내에서도 매장마다 파운드당 가격이 크게 차이 날 수 있는 이유가 바로 이것입니다.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## 관세와 연료비가 계산대에 미치는 영향

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: 진열대의 가격에는 식품 자체의 비용 이상의 것이 포함되어 있습니다.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: 그 가격은 식품을 소비자에게 전달하는 비용을 반영합니다.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **관세.** 많은 기본 식료품은 일부 향신료, 커피, 코코아, 특정 과일 및 채소, 통조림 식품을 포함하여 수입됩니다.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: 수입 관세가 오르면 수입업자와 소매업체는 종종 비용의 최소 일부를 소비자에게 전가합니다.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: 그 영향은 대개 점진적이고 불균등하게 나타납니다.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: 한 제품 범주에 대한 관세는 극적인 가격 급등보다는 수십 가지 품목에 대한 소폭의 가격 인상으로 나타날 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **연료 및 운송.** 식품은 트럭, 철도, 선박, 항공기를 통해 이동합니다.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: 디젤 및 연료 가격이 오르면 운송비가 비싸지고, 그 비용은 신선 농산물부터 냉동식품까지 모든 가격에 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: 냉장 운송은 특히 에너지를 많이 소비하며, 이것이 부패하기 쉬운 품목이 상온 보관 제품보다 가격 압박을 더 크게 느끼는 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **인건비, 포장재, 에너지.** 농장, 가공 공장, 매장 모두 더 높은 운영 비용에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: 포장재와 냉장을 위한 전기료도 그 비용의 일부입니다.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: 이러한 비용은 뉴스 헤드라인을 장식하는 일은 드물지만, 일부 원자재 비용이 완화되어도 왜 가격이 빨리 떨어지지 않는지를 설명해 줍니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## 비용을 줄이는 실질적인 방법

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: 비용을 줄이기 위해 전통적인 식사를 포기할 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: 몇 가지 계획 습관만으로도 큰 차이를 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **인원수와 메뉴부터 정하세요.** 몇 명이 올지 결정하고 쇼핑하기 전에 모든 요리를 적어보세요. 과도한 구매는 명절 식사에서 낭비가 발생하는 가장 흔한 원인 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **현실적으로 분량을 계획하세요.** 일반적인 경험칙은 뼈가 있는 칠면조의 경우 1인당 약 1~1.5파운드이며, 이는 남은 음식을 고려한 양입니다. 필요한 것보다 훨씬 큰 칠면조를 사는 것은 비용과 낭비를 더할 뿐입니다.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **매장 전단지와 앱을 비교하세요.** 매장들은 명절 전 몇 주 동안 칠면조, 통조림, 제빵 재료를 자주 할인합니다. 여러 전단지와 로열티 프로그램을 확인하면 의미 있는 가격 차이를 발견할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **상온 보관 식품은 미리 구매하세요.** 통조림 호박, 육수, 밀가루, 설탕은 세일할 때 몇 주에 걸쳐 미리 사두면 비용을 분산할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **자체 브랜드(PB) 상품을 고려하세요.** 밀가루, 설탕, 통조림 채소, 육수와 같은 기본 품목의 경우, 자체 브랜드 상품은 품질이 비슷하면서도 유명 브랜드보다 저렴한 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **냉동 또는 제철 농산물을 선택하세요.** 냉동 그린빈과 다른 채소들은 신선한 것보다 저렴하면서도 영양가는 비슷할 수 있습니다. 호박, 감자, 크랜베리 같은 제철 품목은 가을에 더 좋은 가치를 제공하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **일부 요리는 직접 만드세요.** 집에서 만든 크랜베리 소스, 스터핑, 롤빵은 보통 사 먹는 것보다 비용이 적게 들지만, 대신 당신의 시간이 들어갑니다.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **부담을 나누세요.** 손님들이 각자 요리를 하나씩 가져오는 포트럭 스타일의 저녁 식사는 비용과 업무량을 분산시킵니다. 중복을 피하기 위해 누가 무엇을 가져올지 명확히 하세요.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **남은 음식을 활용할 계획을 세우세요.** 칠면조 샌드위치, 수프, 캐서롤은 칠면조의 활용도를 높여줍니다. 상하기 전에 남은 음식은 냉동하세요.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **메뉴를 단순화하세요.** 여덟 가지 요리를 어설프게 하는 것보다 두세 가지 요리를 제대로 하는 것이 더 만족스러울 수 있습니다. 요리 한두 가지를 줄이는 것이 비용을 절약하는 가장 쉬운 방법입니다.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## 현실적인 예산 마인드셋

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: 쇼핑 전에 목표를 설정하고 지출을 추적하는 것이 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: 많은 쇼핑객은 작성된 목록, 확고한 예산, 그리고 가격이 높을 때 재료를 대체하려는 의지가 총비용을 통제하는 데 도움이 된다는 것을 알고 있습니다.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: 칠면조가 비싸다면 더 작은 칠면조나 칠면조 가슴살로도 충분할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: 신선 식품이 비싸다면 냉동이나 통조림 제품으로 대체할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: 명절의 의미를 되새겨보는 것도 가치 있는 일입니다.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: 식사가 기억에 남기 위해 반드시 화려할 필요는 없습니다.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: 함께하는 사람들과 잘 만든 몇 가지 요리에 집중하는 주최자들은 종종 그날이 충분히 즐겁고, 비용 부담도 덜하다는 것을 발견합니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: 식료품 가격은 여전히 많은 가구의 고민거리이며, 명절 저녁 식사 비용은 농장 상황부터 무역 정책, 디젤 가격에 이르기까지 모든 것을 반영합니다.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: 당신이 이러한 힘을 통제할 수는 없지만, 어떻게 계획하고, 쇼핑하고, 요리할지는 통제할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: 명확한 메뉴, 약간의 가격 비교, 남은 음식의 현명한 활용을 통해 비용 때문에 명절을 망치지 않으면서도 만족스러운 추수감사절 식사를 차릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not financial advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로만 작성되었으며 재정적 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Prices vary by store and region, so check current local prices when planning your purchases.*
segments.tr: 가격은 매장과 지역에 따라 다르므로 구매 계획을 세울 때 현재 지역 가격을 확인하십시오.*

zh.title: 感恩节餐桌账单：食品价格对今年节日晚餐意味着什么

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: 每年十一月，宴客的主人都面临着同样的数学难题：准备一桌饭菜到底要花多少钱？

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: 今年，许多人在精打细算的同时，食品杂货价格依然居高不下，顽固地高于几年前的水平。

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: 通货膨胀虽已从峰值回落，但增速放缓并不等同于价格下跌。

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: 大多数食品价格已企稳于较高水平，消费者在结账时依然能明显感受到压力。

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: 本指南将解释资金通常流向何处、为什么某些商品价格更高，以及如何在不牺牲美味的前提下精简开支。

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## 钱都花在了哪里

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: 传统的感恩节晚餐由几个主要品类构成。

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: 其中一些品类占据了大部分总支出。

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **主菜。** 火鸡通常是单项开销最大的一笔，尤其是在大型聚会上。价格取决于大小、品牌，以及是新鲜、冷冻、有机还是散养。

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **乳制品与烘焙必需品。** 黄油、奶油、鸡蛋和牛奶几乎出现在每道配菜和甜点中。尤其是黄油和鸡蛋，价格向来波动剧烈。

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **农产品。** 土豆、红薯、绿豆角、蔓越莓、洋葱和芹菜单价并不贵，但为大批客人做饭时，累计起来也是一笔不小的开销。

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **基础储备粮。** 面粉、糖、填料包、罐装南瓜、高汤和香料很容易被忽视，直到你推着装满的购物车站在货架走道前。

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **饮料与小食。** 餐包、饮料和开胃小菜可能会在不知不觉中推高总费用，超出预期。

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## 为什么火鸡价格会大涨

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: 火鸡的成本受远在超市上游的各种因素影响。

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: 动物疫情爆发会导致禽群减少、供应紧张。

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: 饲料成本、人工和加工费用都会反映在批发价中。

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: 零售商还会在节日前的几周将火鸡作为“引流商品（loss leader）”，通过打折吸引顾客进店，再从其他商品上赚回差价。

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么即便在同一个小镇，不同商店之间每磅火鸡的价格也可能相差悬殊。

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## 关税和燃料成本如何影响结账账单

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: 货架上的价格不仅包含食物本身的成本。

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: 它们还反映了将食物运送到你手中的成本。

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **关税。** 许多储备粮商品依赖进口，包括部分香料、咖啡、可可、特定蔬果以及罐头食品。

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: 当进口税上涨时，进口商和零售商通常会将至少部分成本转嫁给消费者。

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: 这种影响通常是渐进且不均匀的。

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: 对某类产品征收关税，可能表现为数十种商品的微小涨价，而非单项商品的剧烈跳涨。

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **燃料与运输。** 食品通过卡车、铁路、轮船和飞机运输。

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: 当柴油和燃料价格上涨时，运费就会变贵，而这笔成本会被计入从新鲜农产品到冷冻食品的所有商品价格中。

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: 冷藏运输的能耗特别大，这也是易腐商品比耐储存商品更容易受到成本冲击的原因之一。

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **人工、包装与能源。** 农场、加工厂和商店都面临着更高的运营成本。

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: 包装材料和冷柜用电也是其中的一部分。

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: 这些开支很少登上头条新闻，但它们解释了为什么即使某些大宗商品成本有所放缓，零售价格却没有迅速下降。

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## 节省开支的实用方法

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: 你无需放弃传统大餐就能减少开支。

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: 几个规划习惯就能带来明显的改变。

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **从确定人数和菜单开始。** 在购物前确定有多少客人来，并写下每道菜。购买过量是节日餐桌上最常见的浪费来源之一。

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **合理规划分量。** 一个通用的经验法则是带骨火鸡每人约 1 到 1.5 磅，这样还能留一些做剩菜。购买远超需求的火鸡会增加成本和浪费。

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **比较商店海报和 App。** 商店通常会在节日临近的前几周对火鸡、罐头食品和烘焙用品打折。查看几家超市的宣传彩页和会员计划能发现不小的差价。

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **提前购买耐储存商品。** 罐装南瓜、高汤、面粉和糖可以在促销时分几周陆陆续续采购，从而分散开支。

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **考虑自有品牌。** 对于面粉、糖、罐头蔬菜和高汤等基础食材，自有品牌的质量通常与知名品牌相当，但价格更便宜。

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **选择冷冻或应季农产品。** 冷冻绿豆角和其他蔬菜可能比新鲜的更便宜，且同样有营养。像南瓜、土豆和蔓越莓这样的应季食材在秋季往往性价比更高。

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **自制部分菜肴。** 自制的蔓越莓酱、填料和餐包通常比商店购买的便宜，不过付出时间也是取舍的一部分。

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **分担开销。** 采用百进餐（Potluck）形式，由每位客人带一道菜，既能分担成本又能减轻工作量。明确谁带什么菜，以避免重复。

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **规划剩菜利用。** 火鸡三明治、汤和炖菜能延长这只火鸡的使用价值。在余料变质前将其冷冻起来。

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **简化菜单。** 精心制作两三道配菜比草草完成八道菜更令人满意。减少一两道菜往往是最简单的省钱方式。

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## 务实的预算心态

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: 在购物前设定目标并在采购过程中记录开支很有帮助。

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: 许多消费者发现，一份书面清单、严格的预算以及在价格高昂时替换食材的意愿，能让总开销保持在可控范围内。

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: 如果整只火鸡太贵，买一只小一点的或只买火鸡胸肉就足够了。

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: 如果新鲜食材昂贵，冷冻或罐装版本完全可以弥补缺口。

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: 同时也值得记住这个节日的真正意义。

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: 一顿饭无需极其丰盛也能令人难忘。

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: 主人们如果把注意力放在陪伴亲友和几道用心制作的菜肴上，往往会发现这一天同样美好，而且账单也更容易接受。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 总结

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: 食品杂货价格仍是许多家庭关注的问题，而节日晚餐的成本反映了从农场状况、贸易政策到柴油价格的一切因素。

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: 你无法控制这些外部力量，但你可以控制自己如何规划、采购和烹饪。

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: 凭着清晰的菜单、适当的对比采购以及对剩菜的聪明利用，你完全可以在不让账单扫兴的前提下，为餐桌献上一顿令人满意的感恩节大餐。

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## टैरिफ और ईंधन लागत चेकआउट लाइन तक कैसे पहुँचती है

segments.tr: शेल्फ पर कीमतों में भोजन की अपनी लागत से अधिक शामिल है।

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: वे उस भोजन को आप तक पहुँचाने की लागत को दर्शाते हैं।

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **टैरिफ (आयात शुल्क)।** कई पेंट्री आइटम आयात किए जाते हैं, जिनमें कुछ मसाले, कॉफी, कोको, कुछ फल और सब्जियां, और डिब्बाबंद सामान शामिल हैं।

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: जब आयात कर बढ़ते हैं, तो आयातक और खुदरा विक्रेता अक्सर खरीदारों पर लागत का कम से कम हिस्सा पास कर देते हैं।

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: प्रभाव आमतौर पर क्रमिक और असमान होता है।

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: एक उत्पाद श्रेणी पर टैरिफ एक नाटकीय मूल्य छलांग के बजाय दर्जनों वस्तुओं पर थोड़ी वृद्धि के रूप में दिखाई दे सकता है।

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **ईंधन और परिवहन।** भोजन ट्रक, रेल, जहाज और विमान से यात्रा करता है।

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: जब डीजल और ईंधन की कीमतें बढ़ती हैं, तो शिपिंग अधिक महंगी हो जाती है, और वह लागत ताजे उपज से लेकर जमे हुए सामान तक हर चीज की कीमत में अंतर्निहित होती है।

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: प्रशीतित परिवहन विशेष रूप से ऊर्जा-सघन है, जो एक कारण है कि जल्दी खराब होने वाली वस्तुएं शेल्फ-स्टेबल वस्तुओं की तुलना में अधिक चुभन महसूस कर सकती हैं।

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **श्रम, पैकेजिंग और ऊर्जा।** खेतों, प्रसंस्करण संयंत्रों और दुकानों को सभी उच्च परिचालन लागतों का सामना करना पड़ता है।

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: पैकेजिंग सामग्री और प्रशीतन के लिए बिजली उस तस्वीर का हिस्सा हैं।

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: ये खर्च शायद ही कभी सुर्खियां बनाते हैं, लेकिन वे यह समझाने में मदद करते हैं कि कुछ कमोडिटी लागत कम होने पर भी कीमतें जल्दी क्यों नहीं गिरती हैं।

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## बिल को कम करने के व्यावहारिक तरीके

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: कम खर्च करने के लिए आपको पारंपरिक भोजन को छोड़ने की आवश्यकता नहीं है।

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: कुछ योजना बनाने की आदतें एक वास्तविक अंतर ला सकती हैं।

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **हेडकाउंट और मेनू से शुरुआत करें।** तय करें कि कितने लोग आ रहे हैं और खरीदारी करने से पहले हर डिश को लिख लें। अधिक खरीदारी करना हॉलिडे भोजन में कचरे के सबसे आम स्रोतों में से एक है।

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **यथार्थवादी रूप से हिस्से की योजना बनाएं।** अंगूठे का एक सामान्य नियम हड्डी वाले पक्षी के लिए प्रति व्यक्ति लगभग एक से डेढ़ पाउंड टर्की है, जो कुछ बचा हुआ छोड़ देता है। जरूरत से बहुत बड़ा पक्षी खरीदना लागत और कचरा जोड़ता है।

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **स्टोर फ़्लायर्स और ऐप्स की तुलना करें।** स्टोर अक्सर छुट्टी के शुरुआती हफ़्तों में टर्की, डिब्बाबंद सामान और बेकिंग आइटम पर छूट देते हैं। कई फ़्लायर्स और लॉयल्टी कार्यक्रमों की जाँच करने से सार्थक अंतर का पता चल सकता है।

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **शेल्फ-स्टेबल आइटम जल्दी खरीदें।** डिब्बाबंद कद्दू, शोरबा, आटा, और चीनी को लागत फैलाते हुए, बिक्री पर जाने पर कई हफ़्तों में उठाया जा सकता है।

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **स्टोर ब्रांडों पर विचार करें।** आटे, चीनी, डिब्बाबंद सब्जियों और शोरबा जैसी मूल बातों के लिए, स्टोर ब्रांड अक्सर गुणवत्ता में तुलनीय होते हैं और नाम ब्रांडों की तुलना में सस्ते होते हैं।

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. ** जमे हुए या इन-सीज़न उपज चुनें।** जमे हुए हरी बीन्स और अन्य सब्जियां ताजी की तुलना में सस्ती और उतनी ही पौष्टिक हो सकती हैं। स्क्वैश, आलू और क्रैनबेरी जैसी मौसमी वस्तुएं पतन में बेहतर मूल्य होने की प्रवृत्ति रखती हैं।

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **खरोंच से कुछ व्यंजन बनाएं।** घर का बना क्रैनबेरी सॉस, स्टफिंग और रोल अक्सर स्टोर से खरीदे गए संस्करणों की तुलना में कम खर्च करते हैं, हालांकि आपका समय ट्रेड-ऑफ का हिस्सा है।

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **भार साझा करें।** एक पॉट्लक-शैली का डिनर, जहाँ मेहमान प्रत्येक एक डिश लाते हैं, लागत और कार्यभार को फैलाता है। डुप्लिकेट से बचने के लिए स्पष्ट रहें कि कौन क्या ला रहा है।

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **बचे हुए खाने की योजना बनाएं।** टर्की सैंडविच, सूप और कैसरोल पक्षी के मूल्य को फैलाते हैं। खराब होने से पहले अतिरिक्त को फ्रीज करें।

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **मेनू को सरल बनाएं।** अच्छी तरह से किए गए दो या तीन पक्ष आधे रास्ते में किए गए आठ से अधिक संतोषजनक हो सकते हैं। एक या दो डिश काटना अक्सर बचाने का सबसे आसान तरीका है।

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## एक यथार्थवादी बजट मानसिकता

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: खरीदारी करने से पहले एक लक्ष्य निर्धारित करना और आगे बढ़ने पर अपने खर्च को ट्रैक करना मदद करता है।

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: कई खरीदार पाते हैं कि एक लिखित सूची, एक दृढ़ बजट, और कीमतें अधिक होने पर सामग्री की अदला-बदली करने की इच्छा कुल नियंत्रण में रखती है।

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: यदि टर्की महंगी है, तो एक छोटा पक्षी या टर्की का स्तन पर्याप्त हो सकता है।

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: यदि ताजी वस्तुएं महंगी हैं, तो जमे हुए या डिब्बाबंद संस्करण अंतर को भर सकते हैं।

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: यह याद रखना भी उचित है कि छुट्टी किस बारे में है।

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: यादगार होने के लिए भोजन का विस्तृत होना आवश्यक नहीं है।

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: जो मेज़बान कंपनी और कुछ अच्छी तरह से बनाई गई डिश पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं, वे अक्सर पाते हैं कि दिन उतना ही अच्छा जाता है, और बिल को पचाना आसान होता है।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: किराने की कीमतें कई परिवारों के लिए एक चिंता का विषय बनी हुई हैं, और एक हॉलिडे डिनर की लागत कृषि स्थितियों से लेकर व्यापार नीति तक डीजल की कीमत तक सब कुछ दर्शाती है।

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: आप उन ताकतों को नियंत्रित नहीं कर सकते, लेकिन आप नियंत्रित कर सकते हैं कि आप कैसे योजना बनाते हैं, खरीदारी करते हैं और खाना बनाते हैं।

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: एक स्पष्ट मेनू, तुलना खरीदारी के एक बिट, और बचे हुए का स्मार्ट उपयोग के साथ, आप बिल को दिन पर कब्जा करने दिए बिना मेज पर एक संतोषजनक थैंक्सगिविंग भोजन रख सकते हैं।

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not financial advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख केवल सामान्य जानकारी के उद्देश्यों के लिए है और वित्तीय सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Prices vary by store and region, so check current local prices when planning your purchases.*
segments.tr: कीमतें स्टोर और क्षेत्र के अनुसार भिन्न होती हैं, इसलिए अपनी खरीदारी की योजना बनाते समय वर्तमान स्थानीय कीमतों की जांच करें।*

es.title: La factura de la mesa de Acción de Gracias: lo que los precios de los alimentos significan para la cena festiva de este año

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: Cada noviembre, los anfitriones se enfrentan al mismo problema de matemáticas: ¿cuánto costará dar de comer a todos en la mesa?

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: Este año, muchos hacen esas cuentas mientras los precios de los comestibles se mantienen tercamente más altos que hace unos años.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: La inflación se ha enfriado desde su punto máximo, pero enfriarse no es lo mismo que bajar.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los precios de los alimentos se han asentado en un nivel más alto, y los compradores todavía lo sienten en la caja registradora.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica a dónde suele ir a parar el dinero, por qué algunos artículos cuestan más que otros y cómo recortar la factura sin sacrificar la comida.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: Las cifras para una tienda o región determinada variarán, así que tome esto como un marco de referencia para la planificación en lugar de una cotización de precios.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## Dónde va el dinero

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: Una cena tradicional de Acción de Gracias se compone de un puñado de categorías.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: Algunas de ellas representan la mayor parte del total.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **El plato principal.** El pavo suele ser el gasto individual más grande, especialmente para reuniones grandes. Los precios dependen del tamaño, la marca y de si el ave es fresca, congelada, orgánica o de pastoreo.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **Lácteos y productos básicos para hornear.** La mantequilla, la crema, los huevos y la leche aparecen en casi todos los acompañamientos y postres. La mantequilla y los huevos en particular suelen sufrir oscilaciones bruscas de precio.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **Frutas y verduras.** Las papas, los camotes, las ejotes, los arándanos rojos, las cebollas y el apio son económicos individualmente, pero se acumulan cuando se cocina para mucha gente.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **Básicos de la despensa.** La harina, el azúcar, la mezcla para relleno, la calabaza en lata, el caldo y las especias son fáciles de pasar por alto hasta que estás en el pasillo con el carrito lleno.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **Bebidas y extras.** Los panecillos, las bebidas y los aperitivos pueden elevar silenciosamente el total más de lo esperado.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## Por qué los precios del pavo pueden dar un salto

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: Los costos del pavo se ven determinados por factores que se sitúan mucho antes de la tienda de comestibles.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: Los brotes de enfermedades animales pueden reducir las bandadas y limitar la oferta.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: Los costos del alimento para animales, la mano de obra y los gastos de procesamiento influyen en el precio al por mayor.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: Los minoristas también utilizan el pavo como un "gancho comercial" en las semanas previas a la festividad, ofreciéndolo con descuento para atrapar clientes a la tienda y compensando la diferencia con otros artículos.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: Por eso el precio por libra puede variar ampliamente de una tienda a otra, incluso en la misma ciudad.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## Cómo los aranceles y los costos del combustible llegan a la caja registradora

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: Los precios en el estante incluyen más que el costo del alimento en sí.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: Reflejan el costo de hacerle llegar ese alimento a usted.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **Aranceles.** Muchos artículos de despensa son importados, incluidas algunas especias, café, cacao, ciertas frutas y verduras, y productos enlatados.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: Cuando suben los impuestos a la importación, los importadores y minoristas a menudo trasladan al menos parte del costo a los compradores.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: El efecto suele ser gradual y desigual.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: Un arancel sobre una categoría de productos puede manifestarse como un pequeño aumento en docenas de artículos, en lugar de un único salto drástico de precio.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **Combustible y transporte.** Los alimentos viajan en camión, tren, barco y avión.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: Cuando suben los precios del diésel y del combustible, el envío se vuelve más caro, y ese costo se incorpora al precio de todo, desde productos frescos hasta congelados.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: El transporte refrigerado requiere un consumo de energía especialmente alto, lo que explica por qué los artículos perecederos pueden sufrir más el impacto que los productos no perecederos.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **Mano de obra, embalaje y energía.** Las granjas, las plantas procesadoras y las tiendas enfrentan costos operativos más altos.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: Los materiales de embalaje y la electricidad para la refrigeración forman parte de ese panorama.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: Estos gastos raras veces acaparan los titulares, pero ayudan a explicar por qué los precios no bajan rápidamente incluso cuando bajan los costos de algunas materias primas.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## Formas prácticas de recortar la factura

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: No hace falta renunciar a la comida tradicional para gastar menos.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: Unos pocos hábitos de planificación pueden marcar una gran diferencia.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **Empiece con un recuento de asistentes y un menú.** Decida cuántas personas vendrán y anote cada plato antes de comprar. Comprar en exceso es una de las fuentes más comunes de desperdicio en las comidas festivas.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **Planifique las porciones de manera realista.** Una regla general habitual es de una a una libra y media de pavo por persona para un pavo con hueso, lo que deja algo para las sobras. Comprar un pavo mucho más grande de lo necesario añade costo y desperdicio.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare catálogos y aplicaciones de las tiendas.** Las tiendas suelen ofrecer descuentos en pavos, conservas y artículos para hornear en las semanas previas a la festividad. Consultar varios folletos y programas de fidelización puede revelar diferencias significativas.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Compre con antelación los productos no perecederos.** La calabaza en lata, el caldo, la harina y el azúcar se pueden ir comprando a lo largo de varias semanas a medida que salen a la venta con descuento, distribuyendo el costo.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **Considere las marcas blancas o de la tienda.** Para productos básicos como harina, azúcar, verduras en conserva y caldo, las marcas de la tienda suelen ser comparables en calidad y más baratas que las marcas reconocidas.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **Elija productos congelados o de temporada.** Los ejotes congelados y otras verduras pueden ser más baratos que los frescos e igual de nutritivos. Los productos de temporada como la calabaza, las papas y los arándanos rojos suelen tener mejor precio en otoño.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **Prepare algunos platos desde cero.** La salsa de arándanos hecha en casa, el relleno y los panecillos a menudo cuestan menos que las versiones compradas en la tienda, aunque su tiempo forma parte de la compensación.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **Comparta la carga.** Una cena estilo "potluck", donde cada invitado trae un plato, distribuye el costo y el trabajo. Deje claro quién trae qué para evitar duplicados.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **Planifique qué hacer con las sobras.** Los sándwiches de pavo, la sopa y los guisos maximizan el valor del ave. Congele el exceso antes de que se eche a perder.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **Simplifique el menú.** Dos o tres acompañamientos bien hechos pueden ser más satisfactorios que ocho hechos a medias. Eliminar un plato o dos suele ser la forma más fácil de ahorrar.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## Una mentalidad de presupuesto realista

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: Ayuda fijar un objetivo antes de comprar y hacer un seguimiento de sus gastos a medida que avanza.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: Muchos compradores descubren que una lista escrita, un presupuesto firme y la disposición a cambiar ingredientes cuando los precios están altos mantienen el total bajo control.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Si el pavo está caro, un ave más pequeña o una pechuga de pavo pueden ser suficientes.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Si los artículos frescos son costosos, las versiones congeladas o en conserva pueden suplir la diferencia.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: También vale la pena recordar de qué trata esta festividad.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Una comida no necesita ser elaborada para ser memorable.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: Los anfitriones que se concentran en la compañía y en unos pocos platos bien preparados a menudo encuentran que el día sale igual de bien y la factura es más fácil de digerir.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En conclusión

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: Los precios de los comestibles siguen siendo una preocupación para muchos hogares, y el costo de una cena festiva refleja de todo, desde las condiciones agrícolas hasta la política comercial y el precio del diésel.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: Usted no puede controlar esas fuerzas, pero sí puede controlar cómo planifica, compra y cocina.

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: Con un menú claro, un poco de comparación de compras y un uso inteligente de las sobras, puede poner una comida de Acción de Gracias satisfactoria en la mesa sin dejar que la factura se apodere del día.

ar.title: فاتورة طاولة عيد الشكر: ما تعنيه أسعار الطعام لعشاء عطلة هذا العام

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: في كل شهر نوفمبر، يواجه المضيفون نفس مشكلة الحسابات: كم ستكلفة إطعام الجميع على الطاولة؟

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: هذا العام، يقوم الكثيرون بإجراء تلك الحسابات بينما تظل أسعار البقالة مرتفعة بعناد مقارنة بما كانت عليه قبل بضع سنوات.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: لقد انخفض التضخم عن ذروته، لكن التباطؤ لا يماثل الانخفاض.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: لقد استقرت معظم أسعار المواد الغذائية عند مستوى أعلى، وما زال المتسوقون يشعرون بذلك عند الدفع.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: يوضح هذا الدليل أين تذهب الأموال غالباً، ولماذا تكلف بعض المواد أكثر من غيرها، وكيفية تقليص الفاتورة دون التضحية بالوجبة.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: ستختلف الأرقام لأي متجر أو منطقة معينة، لذا اعتبر هذا إطاراً للتخطيط وليس عرضاً للسعر.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## أين تذهب الأموال

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: يتم بناء عشاء عيد الشكر التقليدي من عدد قليل من الفئات.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: بعضها يشكل الجزء الأكبر من المجموع.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **الطبق الرئيسي.** عادة ما يكون الديك الرومي هو أكبر بند منفرد، خاصة التجمعات الكبيرة. تعتمد الأسعار على الحجم والعلامة التجارية وما إذا كان الطائر طازجاً أم مجمداً أم عضويًا أم مربى على المراعي.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **منتجات الألبان وأساسيات الخبز.** تظهر الزبدة والقشدة والبيض والحليب فيเกือบ كل طبق جانبي وحلوى. وقد عرفت الزبدة والبيض بشكل خاص بتقلبات حادة في الأسعار.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **المنتجات الطازجة.** البطاطس، البطاطس الحلوة، الفاصوليا الخضراء، التوت البري، البصل، والكرفس رخيصة الثمن فردياً، لكنها تتراكم عندما تطبخ لحشد كبير.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **أسساسيات المؤونة.** الدقيق، السكر، مزيج الحشو، اليقطين المعلب، مرق اللحم، والتوابل يسهل تجاهلها حتى تقف في الممر مع عربة مليئة.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **المشروبات والإضافات.** يمكن للخبز والمشروبات والمقبلات أن ترفع المجموع بهدوء أكثر من المتوقع.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## لماذا قد ترتفع أسعار الديك الرومي

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: تتحدد تكاليف الديك الرومي بعوامل تقع بعيداً في المنبع عن متجر البقالة.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: يمكن لتفشي أمراض الحيوانات أن يقلص القطعان ويضيق الإمدادات.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: تساهم تكاليف الأعلاف والعمالة ونفقات المعالجة في سعر الجملة.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: كما يستخدم تجار التجزئة الديك الرومي "كطعم لجذب العملاء" في الأسابيع التي تسبق العطلة، حيث يقدمون تخفيضات عليه لجذب المتسوقين إلى المتجر وتعويض الفارق من عناصر أخرى.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: لهذا السبب يمكن أن يختلف السعر لكل رطل بشكل كبير من متجر إلى آخر، حتى في نفس المدينة.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## كيف تصل الرسوم الجمركية وتكاليف الوقود إلى شباك الدفع

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: تشمل الأسعار على الرف أكثر من تكلفة الطعام نفسه.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: فهي تعكس تكلفة توصيل ذلك الطعام إليك.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **الرسوم الجمركية.** يتم استيراد العديد من عناصر المؤونة، بما في ذلك بعض التوابل والقهوة والكاكاو وبعض الفواكه والخضروات والأغذية المعلبة.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع ضرائب الاستيراد، غالباً ما ينقل المستوردون وتجار التجزئة جزءاً على الأقل من التكلفة إلى المتسوقين.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: يكون التأثير تدريجياً وغير متساوٍ عادة.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: قد تظهر الرسوم الجمركية على فئة منتج واحدة كزيادة طفيفة على عشرات العناصر، بدلاً من قفزة سعرية دراماتيكية واحدة.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **الوقود والنقل.** ينتقل الطعام عبر الشاحنات والقطارات والسفن والطائرات.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع أسعار الديزل والوقود، تصبح الشحن أكثر تكلفة، وتُبنى هذه التكلفة في سعر كل شيء من المنتجات الطازجة إلى السلع المجمدة.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: النقل المبرد كثيف الطاقة بشكل خاص، وهو أحد الأسباب التي تجعل العناصر القابلة للتلف تشعر بالضغط أكثر من تلك المستقرة على الرف.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **العمالة والتعبئة والطاقة.** تواجه المزارع ومحطات المعالجة والمتاجر تكاليف تشغيل أعلى.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: تعد مواد التعبئة والتغليف والكهرباء للتبريد جزءاً من تلك الصورة.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: نادراً ما تتصدر هذه النفقات عناوين الأخبار، لكنها تساعد في تفسير سبب عدم انخفاض الأسعار بسرعة حتى عندما تنخفض بعض تكاليف السلع الأساسية.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## طرق عملية لتقليص الفاتورة

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: لا تحتاج إلى التخلي عن الوجبة التقليدية لتنفاق أقل.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: يمكن لبعض عادات التخطيط أن تحدث فرقاً حقيقياً.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **ابدأ بعدد الأشخاص وقائمة الطعام.** حدد عدد القادمين واكتب كل طبق قبل التسوق. الشراء المفرط هو أحد أكثر مصادر الهدر شيوعاً في وجبات العطلات.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **خطط للحصص بشكل واقعي.** القاعدة العامة الشائعة هي حوالي رطل إلى رطل ونصف من الديك الرومي لكل شخص لطائر يحتوي على عظم، مما يترك بعضاً لبقايا الطعام. شراء طائر أكبر بكثير مما تحتاج يضيف تكلفة وهدراً.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **قارن بين منشورات المتاجر والتطبيقات.** غالباً ما يقدم تجار التجزئة تخفيضات على الديك الرومي والمعلبات ومستلزمات الخبز في الأسابيع التي تسبق العطلة. فحص عدة منشورات وبرامج ولاء يمكن أن يكشف عن اختلافات ذات مغزى.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **اشترِ العناصر المستقرة على الرف مبكراً.** يمكن شراء اليقطين المعلب والمرق والدقيق والسكر على مدى عدة أسابيع أثناء عرضها للبيع، مما ينشر التكلفة.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **فكر في العلامات التجارية للمتاجر.** بالنسبة للأساْسيات مثل الدقيق والسكر والخضروات المعلبة والمرق، غالباً ما تكون العلامات التجارية للمتاجر قابلة للمقارنة في الجودة وأرخص من العلامات التجارية الشهيرة.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **اختر المنتجات المجمدة أو الموسمية.** يمكن أن تكون الفاصوليا الخضراء المجمدة والخضروات الأخرى أرخص من الطازجة ومغذية بنفس القدر. تميل العناصر الموسمية مثل القرع والبطاطس والتوت البري إلى أن تكون ذات قيمة أفضل في الخريف.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **اصنع بعض الأطباق من الصفر.** غالباً ما تكلف صلصة التوت البري والحشو والخبز المصنوعة منزلياً أقل من النسخ الجاهزة، على الرغم من أن وقتك هو جزء من المقايضة.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **شارك العبء.** عشاء على نمط المساهمة، حيث يحضر الضيوف طبقاً، يوزع التكلفة عبء العمل. كن واضحاً بشأن من يحضر ماذا لتجنب التكرار.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **خطط لبقايا الطعام.** سندويشات الديك الرومي، الحساء، والأطباق المخبوزة تمدد قيمة الطائر. قم بتجميد الفائض قبل أن يفسد.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **بسّط القائمة.** طبقان جانبيان أو ثلاثة يتم إعدادها جيداً يمكن أن تكون أكثر إشباعاً من ثمانية تم إعدادها بشكل نصفّي. قطع طبق أو طبقين غالباً ما يكون أسهل طريقة للتوفير.

segments.tr: ## عقليّة ميزانية واقعية

fr.title: La facture de la table de Thanksgiving : ce que signifient les prix des denrées alimentaires pour le repas de fête de cette année

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: Chaque mois de novembre, les hôtes font face au même problème mathématique : combien cela coûtera-t-il de nourrir tout le monde à table ?

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: Cette année, beaucoup font ce calcul alors que les prix de l'épicerie restent obstinément plus élevés qu'il y a quelques années.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: L'inflation a ralenti par rapport à son pic, mais ralentir ne signifie pas baisser.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: La plupart des prix alimentaires se sont stabilisés à un niveau plus élevé, et les acheteurs le ressentent toujours à la caisse.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: Ce guide explique où va généralement l'argent, pourquoi certains articles coûtent plus cher que d'autres et comment réduire la facture sans sacrifier le repas.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: Les chiffres pour un magasin ou une région donnée varieront, alors considérez ceci comme un cadre de planification plutôt que comme un devis.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## Où va l'argent

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: Un dîner de Thanksgiving traditionnel est composé d'une poignée de catégories.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: Certaines d'entre elles constituent la majeure partie du total.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **Le plat principal.** La dinde est généralement le poste de dépense le plus important, en particulier pour les grands rassemblements. Les prix dépendent de la taille, de la marque et de la nature fraîche, surgelée, biologique ou élevée en plein air de la volaille.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **Produits laitiers et essentiels de la pâtisserie.** Le beurre, la crème, les œufs et le lait apparaissent dans presque tous les plats d'accompagnement et desserts. Le beurre et les œufs en particulier sont connus pour fluctuer brusquement de prix.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **Fruits et légumes.** Les pommes de terre, les patates douces, les haricots verts, les canneberges, les oignons et le céleri sont individuellement bon marché, mais ils s'accumulent lorsque vous cuisinez pour une foule.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **Bases du garde-manger.** La farine, le sucre, la préparation pour farce, la citrouille en conserve, le bouillon et les épices sont faciles à oublier jusqu'à ce que vous soyez dans l'allée avec un chariot plein.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **Boissons et extras.** Les petits pains, les boissons et les hors-d'œuvre peuvent discrètement faire monter le total plus que prévu.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les prix de la dinde peuvent s'envoler

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: Les coûts de la dinde sont façonnés par des facteurs qui se situent bien en amont de l'épicerie.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: Les épidémies de maladies animales peuvent réduire les troupeaux et resserrer l'offre.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: Les coûts des aliments pour animaux, de la main-d'œuvre et des dépenses de transformation contribuent tous au prix de gros.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: Les détaillants utilisent également les dindes comme « produit d'appel » dans les semaines précédant les fêtes, en les soldant pour attirer les acheteurs dans le magasin et en rattrapant la différence sur d'autres articles.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi le prix au kilo peut varier considérablement d'un magasin à l'autre, même dans la même ville.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## Comment les tarifs douaniers et les coûts du carburant atteignent la caisse

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: Les prix en rayon incluent plus que le coût de la nourriture elle-même.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: Ils reflètent le coût de l'acheminement de cette nourriture jusqu'à vous.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **Tarifs douaniers.** De nombreux articles de garde-manger sont importés, notamment certaines épices, le café, le cacao, certains fruits et légumes, et les conserves.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: Lorsque les taxes à l'importation augmentent, les importateurs et les détaillants répercutent souvent au moins une partie du coût sur les acheteurs.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: L'effet est généralement progressif et inégal.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: Un droit de douane sur une catégorie de produits peut se traduire par une petite augmentation sur des dizaines d'articles, plutôt que par une hausse de prix spectaculaire.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **Carburant et transport.** La nourriture voyage par camion, train, bateau et avion.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: Lorsque les prix du diesel et du carburant augmentent, le transport devient plus cher, et ce coût est intégré dans le prix de tout, des produits frais aux produits surgelés.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: Le transport réfrigéré est particulièrement gourmand en énergie, ce qui explique en partie pourquoi les produits périssables peuvent ressentir la pression plus que les produits non périssables.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **Main-d'œuvre, emballage et énergie.** Les fermes, les usines de transformation et les magasins font tous face à des coûts d'exploitation plus élevés.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: Les matériaux d'emballage et l'électricité pour la réfrigération font partie de ce tableau.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: Ces dépenses font rarement la une des journaux, mais elles aident à expliquer pourquoi les prix ne baissent pas rapidement même lorsque certains coûts des matières premières diminuent.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## Moyens pratiques de réduire la facture

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: Vous n'avez pas besoin de renoncer au repas traditionnel pour dépenser moins.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes de planification peuvent faire une réelle différence.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **Commencez par le nombre de personnes et un menu.** Décidez combien de personnes viennent et écrivez chaque plat avant de faire vos courses. Acheter trop est l'une des sources de gaspillage les plus courantes lors des repas de fêtes.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **Planifiez les portions de manière réaliste.** Une règle générale courante est d'environ une livre à une livre et demie de dinde par personne pour une volaille avec os, ce qui en laisse un peu pour les restes. Acheter une volaille beaucoup plus grande que nécessaire ajoute des coûts et du gaspillage.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **Comparez les circulaires et applications des magasins.** Les magasins réduisent souvent le prix de la dinde, des conserves et des articles de boulangerie dans les semaines précédant les fêtes. Consulter plusieurs circulaires et programmes de fidélité peut révéler des différences significatives.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Achetez tôt les produits non périssables.** La citrouille en conserve, le bouillon, la farine et le sucre peuvent être achetés sur plusieurs semaines au fur et à mesure qu'ils sont en solde, ce qui étale le coût.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **Envisagez les marques distributeurs.** Pour les produits de base tels que la farine, le sucre, les légumes en conserve et le bouillon, les marques de distributeur sont souvent comparables en termes de qualité et moins chères que les grandes marques.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **Choisissez des produits surgelés ou de saison.** Les haricots verts surgelés et autres légumes peuvent être moins chers que les frais et tout aussi nutritifs. Les articles de saison comme la courge, les pommes de terre et les canneberges ont tendance à offrir un meilleur rapport qualité-prix en automne.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **Préparez certains plats maison.** La sauce aux canneberges, la farce et les petits pains faits maison coûtent souvent moins cher que les versions achetées en magasin, bien que votre temps fasse partie du compromis.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **Partagez la charge.** Un dîner de type pot-luck, où chaque invité apporte un plat, répartit le coût et la charge de travail. Soyez clair sur qui apporte quoi pour éviter les doublons.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **Prévoyez les restes.** Les sandwichs à la dinde, la soupe et les gratins prolongent la valeur de la voleille. Congelez les surplus avant qu'ils ne se gâtent.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **Simplifiez le menu.** Deux ou trois accompagnements bien faits peuvent être plus satisfaisants que huit faits à moitié. Supprimer un ou deux plats est souvent le moyen le plus simple d'économiser.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## Un état d'esprit budgétaire réaliste

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: Il est utile de se fixer un objectif avant de faire ses courses et de suivre ses dépenses au fur et à mesure.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: De nombreux acheteurs constatent qu'une liste écrite, un budget ferme et la volonté de remplacer des ingrédients lorsque les prix sont élevés permettent de garder le total sous contrôle.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Si la dinde est chère, une volaille plus petite ou une poitrine de dinde peut suffire.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Si les produits frais sont chers, les versions surgelées ou en conserve peuvent combler le vide.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: Il est également utile de se rappeler le sens de cette fête.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Un repas n'a pas besoin d'être élaboré pour être mémorable.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: Les hôtes qui se concentrent sur la compagnie et quelques plats bien faits constatent souvent que la journée se déroule tout aussi bien, et que la facture est plus facile à avaler.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.tr: Les prix des produits alimentaires restent une source de préoccupation pour de nombreux ménages, et le coût d'un repas de fête reflète tout, des conditions agricoles à la politique commerciale en passant par le prix du diesel.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: Vous ne pouvez pas contrôler ces forces, mais vous pouvez contrôler la façon dont vous planifiez, achetez et cuisinez.
