segments.tr: Quando os preços do diesel e do combustível aumentam, o transporte fica mais caro, e esse custo é embutido no preço de tudo, desde produtos frescos até produtos congelados.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: O transporte refrigerado consome muita energia, o que é uma razão pela qual os itens perecíveis podem sentir mais o impacto do que os não perecíveis.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **Mão de obra, embalagem e energia.** Fazendas, fábricas de processamento e lojas enfrentam custos operacionais mais altos.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: Materiais de embalagem e eletricidade para refrigeração fazem parte desse cenário.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: Essas despesas raramente estampam manchetes, mas ajudam a explicar por que os preços não caem rapidamente mesmo quando alguns custos de commodities diminuem.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## Maneiras Práticas de Reduzir a Conta

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: Você não precisa abrir mão da refeição tradicional para gastar menos.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: Alguns hábitos de planejamento podem fazer uma diferença real.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **Comece com a contagem de pessoas e um menu.** Decida quantas pessoas virão e anote cada prato antes de fazer compras. Comprar em excesso é uma das fontes mais comuns de desperdício em refeições de feriado.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **Planeje as porções de forma realista.** Uma regra prática comum é cerca de meio quilo a setecentos gramas de peru por pessoa para uma ave com osso, o que deixa algumas sobras. Comprar uma ave muito maior do que você precisa adiciona custo e desperdício.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **Compare panfletos de lojas e aplicativos.** As lojas frequentemente dão descontos em peru, enlatados e itens de panificação nas semanas que antecedem o feriado. Verificar vários panfletos e programas de fidelidade pode revelar diferenças significativas.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Compre itens não perecíveis mais cedo.** Abóbora enlatada, caldo, farinha e açúcar podem ser comprados ao longo de várias semanas conforme entram em promoção, espalhando o custo.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **Considere marcas próprias.** Para itens básicos como farinha, açúcar, vegetais enlatados e caldo, as marcas próprias são frequentemente comparáveis em qualidade e mais baratas que as marcas famosas.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **Escolha produtos congelados ou da estação.** Vagens congeladas e outros vegetais podem ser mais baratos que os frescos e igualmente nutritivos. Itens sazonais como abóbora, batatas e cranberries tendem a ter melhores valores no outono.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **Faça alguns pratos do zero.** Molho de cranberry caseiro, recheio e pães geralmente custam menos do que as versões compradas prontas, embora seu tempo faça parte da troca.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **Divida a carga.** Um jantar estilo contribuição (potluck), onde os convidados trazem um prato cada, espalha o custo e a carga de trabalho. Seja claro sobre quem está trazêndo o quê para evitar duplicatas.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **Planeje as sobras.** Sanduíches de peru, sopa e caçarolas estendem o valor da ave. Congele os extras antes que estraguem.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **Simplifique o menu.** Dois ou três acompanhamentos bem feitos podem ser mais satisfatórios do que oito feitos pela metade. Cortar um prato ou dois é frequentemente a maneira mais fácil de economizar.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## Uma Mentalidade de Orçamento Realista

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: Ajuda definir uma meta antes de comprar e acompanhar seus gastos à medida que avança.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: Muitos consumidores descobrem que uma lista escrita, um orçamento firme e a disposição de trocar ingredientes quando os preços estão altos mantêm o total sob controle.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Se o peru estiver caro, uma ave menor ou um peito de peru pode ser suficiente.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Se os itens frescos estiverem caros, versões congeladas ou enlatadas podem preencher a lacuna.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: Também vale a pena lembrar qual é o objetivo do feriado.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Uma refeição não precisa ser elaborada para ser memorável.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: Anfitriões que focam na companhia e em alguns pratos bem feitos frequentemente descobrem que o dia corre muito bem, e a conta é mais fácil de digerir.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## O Conclusão

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: Os preços dos supermercados continuam sendo uma preocupação para muitas famílias, e o custo de um jantar de feriado reflete desde as condições agrícolas até a política comercial e o preço do diesel.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: Você não pode controlar essas forças, mas pode controlar como planeja, faz compras e cozinha.

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: Com um menu claro, um pouco de comparação de preços e uso inteligente de sobras, você pode colocar uma refeição satisfatória de Ação de Graças na mesa sem deixar que a conta domine o dia.

in.title: Undang-Undang Meja Makan Thanksgiving: Arti Harga Makanan untuk Makan Malam Liburan Tahun Ini

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: Setiap bulan November, tuan rumah menghadapi masalah matematika yang sama: berapa biaya untuk memberi makan semua orang di meja?

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: Tahun ini, banyak yang melakukan perhitungan tersebut sementara harga bahan makanan tetap bertahan lebih tinggi daripada beberapa tahun lalu.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: Inflasi telah mereda dari puncaknya, tetapi mereda tidak sama dengan turun.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar harga makanan telah menetap di level yang lebih tinggi, dan pembeli masih merasakannya di kasir.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: Panduan ini menjelaskan ke mana uang biasanya pergi, mengapa beberapa barang berharga lebih mahal daripada yang lain, dan bagaimana cara memangkas tagihan tanpa mengorbankan makanan.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: Angka untuk toko atau wilayah tertentu akan bervariasi, jadi anggap ini sebagai kerangka kerja untuk perencanaan daripada kutipan harga.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## Ke Mana Uang Pergi

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: Makan malam Thanksgiving tradisional dibangun dari segelintir kategori.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: Beberapa di antaranya merupakan sebagian besar dari total.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **Hidangan utama.** Kalkun biasanya merupakan item baris tunggal terbesar, terutama untuk pertemuan besar. Harga tergantung pada ukuran, merek, dan apakah burung itu segar, beku, organik, atau dibesarkan di padang rumput.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **Produk susu dan kebutuhan pokok kue.** Mentega, krim, telur, dan susu muncul di hampir setiap hidangan pendamping dan makanan penutup. Mentega dan telur khususnya dikenal berfluktuasi tajam dalam harga.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **Hasil bumi.** Kentang, ubi jalar, kacang hijau, cranberry, bawang, dan seledri masing-masing murah, tetapi bertambah banyak ketika Anda memasak untuk orang banyak.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **Kebutuhan pokok pantri.** Tepung, gula, campuran isian, labu kalengan, kaldu, dan rempah-rempah mudah diabaikan sampai Anda berdiri di lorong dengan kereta penuh.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **Minuman dan tambahan.** Roti gulung, minuman, dan makanan pembuka dapat diam-diam mendorong total lebih tinggi dari yang diharapkan.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Harga Kalkun Bisa Melonjak

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: Biaya kalkun dibentuk oleh faktor-faktor yang berada jauh di hulu dari toko kelontong.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: Wabah penyakit hewan dapat menyusutkan kawanan dan memperketat pasokan.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: Biaya pakan, tenaga kerja, dan biaya pemrosesan semuanya masuk ke dalam harga grosir.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: Pengecer juga menggunakan kalkun sebagai "pemimpin kerugian" pada minggu-minggu sebelum liburan, mendiskonnya untuk menarik pembeli ke toko dan menutupi perbedaan pada barang lain.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya harga per pon bisa sangat bervariasi dari satu toko ke toko berikutnya, bahkan di kota yang sama.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Tarif dan Biaya Bahan Bakar Mencapai Jalur Kasir

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: Harga di rak mencakup lebih dari sekadar biaya makanan itu sendiri.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: Mereka mencerminkan biaya untuk mendapatkan makanan itu kepada Anda.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **Tarif.** Banyak barang pantri yang diimpor, termasuk beberapa rempah-rempah, kopi, kakao, buah-buahan dan sayuran tertentu, dan makanan kaleng.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: Ketika pajak impor naik, importir dan pengecer sering meneruskan setidaknya sebagian dari biaya tersebut kepada pembeli.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: Efeknya biasanya bertahap dan tidak merata.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: Tarif pada satu kategori produk dapat muncul sebagai kenaikan kecil pada lusinan item, daripada satu lonjakan harga yang dramatis.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **Bahan bakar dan transportasi.** Makanan berjalan dengan truk, kereta api, kapal, dan pesawat.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: Ketika harga solar dan bahan bakar naik, pengiriman menjadi lebih mahal, dan biaya itu dimasukkan ke dalam harga segala sesuatu mulai dari produk segar hingga barang beku.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: Transportasi berpendingin sangat intensif energi, yang merupakan salah satu alasan barang yang mudah rusak dapat merasakan cubitan lebih daripada barang yang stabil di rak.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **Tenaga kerja, pengemasan, dan energi.** Pertanian, pabrik pengolahan, dan toko semuanya menghadapi biaya operasional yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: Bahan pengemasan dan listrik untuk pendinginan adalah bagian dari gambar itu.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: Biaya ini jarang menjadi berita utama, tetapi membantu menjelaskan mengapa harga tidak turun dengan cepat bahkan ketika beberapa biaya komoditas mereda.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## Cara Praktis untuk Memangkas Tagihan

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: Anda tidak perlu menyerahkan makanan tradisional untuk menghabiskan lebih sedikit.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: Beberapa kebiasaan perencanaan dapat membuat perbedaan nyata.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **Mulailah dengan jumlah kepala dan menu.** Tentukan berapa banyak orang yang datang dan tuliskan setiap hidangan sebelum Anda berbelanja. Pembelian berlebihan adalah salah satu sumber limbah paling umum pada waktu makan liburan.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **Rencanakan porsi secara realistis.** Aturan praktis yang umum adalah sekitar satu hingga satu setengah pon kalkun per orang untuk burung bertulang, yang menyisakan beberapa untuk sisa makanan. Membeli burung yang jauh lebih besar dari yang Anda butuhkan menambah biaya dan limbah.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **Bandingkan brosur dan aplikasi toko.** Toko sering mendiskon kalkun, makanan kaleng, dan barang-barang kue pada minggu-minggu menjelang liburan. Memeriksa beberapa brosur dan program loyalitas dapat mengungkapkan perbedaan yang berarti.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Beli barang yang stabil di rak lebih awal.** Labu kaleng, kaldu, tepung, dan gula dapat diambil selama beberapa minggu saat mereka mulai diobral, menyebarkan biayanya.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **Pertimbangkan merek toko.** Untuk kebutuhan pokok seperti tepung, gula, sayuran kaleng, dan kaldu, merek toko seringkali sebanding dalam kualitas dan lebih murah daripada merek nama.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **Pilih hasil bumi beku atau musiman.** Kacang hijau beku dan sayuran lainnya bisa lebih murah daripada yang segar dan sama bergizi. Barang musiman seperti labu, kentang, dan cranberry cenderung menjadi nilai yang lebih baik di musim gugur.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **Buat beberapa hidangan dari awal.** Saus cranberry buatan sendiri, isian, dan roti gulung seringkali berharga lebih murah daripada versi buatan toko, meskipun waktu Anda adalah bagian dari pertukaran.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **Bagikan bebannya.** Makan malam gaya potluck, di mana para tamu masing-masing membawa hidangan, menyebarkan biaya dan beban kerja. Jelaskan tentang siapa yang membawa apa untuk menghindari duplikat.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **Rencanakan sisa makanan.** Sandwich kalkun, sup, dan kaserol meregangkan nilai burung tersebut. Bekukan tambahan sebelum rusak.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **Sederhanakan menu.** Dua atau tiga sisi yang dilakukan dengan baik bisa lebih memuaskan daripada delapan yang dilakukan setengah jalan. Memotong satu atau dua hidangan sering kali merupakan cara termudah untuk berhemat.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## Pola Pikir Anggaran yang Realistis

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: Sangat membantu untuk menetapkan target sebelum Anda berbelanja dan melacak pengeluaran Anda saat Anda pergi.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: Banyak pembeli menemukan bahwa daftar tertulis, anggaran yang kuat, dan kemauan untuk menukar bahan ketika harga tinggi menjaga total tetap terkendali.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Jika kalkun itu mahal, burung yang lebih kecil atau dada kalkun mungkin sudah cukup.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Jika barang segar mahal, versi beku atau kalengan dapat mengisi celah tersebut.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: Perlu juga diingat tentang apa liburan itu.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Makanan tidak harus rumit untuk diingat.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: Tuan rumah yang berfokus pada perusahaan dan beberapa hidangan yang dibuat dengan baik sering menemukan bahwa hari berjalan dengan baik, dan tagihannya lebih mudah ditelan.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Garis Bawah

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: Harga bahan makanan tetap menjadi kekhawatiran bagi banyak rumah tangga, dan biaya makan malam liburan mencerminkan segalanya mulai dari kondisi pertanian hingga kebijakan perdagangan hingga harga solar.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: Anda tidak dapat mengontrol kekuatan tersebut, tetapi Anda dapat mengontrol bagaimana Anda merencanakan, berbelanja, dan memasak.

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: Dengan menu yang jelas, sedikit belanja perbandingan, dan penggunaan sisa makanan yang cerdas, Anda dapat meletakkan makanan Thanksgiving yang memuaskan di atas meja tanpa membiarkan tagihan mengambil alih hari.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## お金がどこに行くのか

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: 伝統的な感謝祭のディナーは、いくつかのカテゴリーから成り立っています。

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: そのうちのいくつかは合計の大半を占めています。

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **メインコース。** 七面鳥は通常、特に大勢の集まりにおいて、単一の最大の品目です。価格はサイズ、ブランド、そして鳥が新鮮か、冷凍か、オーガニックか、放し飼いかによって異なります。

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **乳製品とベーキングの必需品。** バター、クリーム、卵、牛乳は、ほぼすべてのサイドディッシュやデザートに登場します。特にバターと卵は価格が激しく変動することで知られています。

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **農産物。** じゃがいも、さつまいも、インゲン、クランベリー、タマネギ、セロリは個々には安価ですが、大人数のために料理すると積み重なります。

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **パントリーの基本。** 小麦粉、砂糖、スタッフィングミックス、缶詰のカボチャ、ブロス、スパイスは、カートがいっぱいの状態で通路に立つまで見落としがちです。

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **飲み物と追加の品物。** ロールパン、飲み物、前菜は、予想以上に合計を静かに押し上げる可能性があります。

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## 七面鳥の価格が跳ね上がる理由

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: 七面鳥のコストは、食料品店のずっと上流にある要因によって形作られています。

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: 動物の病気の発生は、群れを縮小させ、供給を締め付ける可能性があります。

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: 飼料コスト、労働力、加工費のすべてが卸売価格に反映されます。

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: 小売業者はまた、休日の数週間前に七面鳥を「ロスリーダー」として使用し、買い物客を店に引き付けるために割引し、他の品物で差額を埋めます。

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: それが、同じ町であっても、1つの店から次の店へとポンドあたりの価格が大きく異なる理由です。

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## 関税と燃料コストがチェックアウトラインに届く仕組み

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: 棚の価格には、食料自体のコスト以上のものが含まれています。

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: それらはその食料をあなたに届けるコストを反映しています。

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **関税。** 多くのパントリーアイテムは輸入されており、一部のスパイス、コーヒー、ココア、特定の果物や野菜、缶詰が含まれます。

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: 輸入税が上昇すると、輸入業者や小売業者は多くの場合、コストの少なくとも一部を買い物客に転嫁します。

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: その影響は通常、段階的であり、不均一です。

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: 1つの製品カテゴリに対する関税は、1つの劇的な価格の跳ね上がりではなく、数十のアイテムに対する小さな値上がりとして現れることがあります。

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **燃料と輸送。** 食品はトラック、鉄道、船、飛行機で移動します。

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: ディーゼルや燃料の価格が上がると、輸送の費用が高くなり、そのコストは生鮮食品から冷凍食品に至るまですべての価格に組み込まれます。

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: 冷蔵輸送は特にエネルギー集約型であり、それが生鮮品が棚持ちのよいものよりも打撃を受けやすい理由の1つです。

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **労働力、包装、エネルギー。** 農場、加工工場、店舗のすべてが高い運営コストに直面しています。

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: 包装材料と冷蔵用の電力はその一部です。

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: これらの費用がニュースの見出しになることはめったにありませんが、一部の商品コストが緩和されたときでも価格がすぐに下がらない理由を説明するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## 請求額を削減する実用的な方法

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: 支出を減らすために伝統的な食事を諦める必要はありません。

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: いくつかの計画の習慣は、本当の違いを生み出すことができます。

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **出席人数とメニューから始める。** 何人来るかを決定し、買い物をする前にすべての料理を書き留めてください。買いすぎは、ホリデーの食事で最も一般的な廃棄の発生源の1つです。

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: **ポーションを現実的に計画する。** 一般的な目安は、骨付きの鳥の場合、1人あたり約1ポンドから1ポンド半の七面鳥であり、残り物をいくつか残します。必要以上にずっと大きな鳥を買うと、コストと廃棄物が増加します。

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **店舗のチラシとアプリを比較する。** 店舗では、休日に先立つ数週間に、七面鳥、缶詰、ベーキングアイテムをしばしば割引します。いくつかのチラシやロイヤルティプログラムを確認すると、意味のある違いが明らかになることがあります。

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **棚持ちの良いアイテムを早めに購入する。** 缶詰のカボチャ、ブロス、小麦粉、砂糖は、セールになるにつれて数週間にわたって拾うことができ、コストを分散させることができます。

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **ストアブランドを検討する。** 小麦粉、砂糖、缶詰の野菜、ブロスなどの基本については、ストアブランドは多くの場合、ブランド品と同等の品質であり、より安価です。

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **冷凍または旬の農産物を選ぶ。** 冷凍のインゲンやその他の野菜は、新鮮なものよりも安く、同じように栄養価が高い場合があります。カボチャ、じゃがいも、クランベリーのような季節のアイテムは、秋により良い価値になる傾向があります。

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **いくつかの料理を一から作る。** 自家製のクランベリーソース、スタッフィング、ロールパンは、お店で買ったバージョンよりもコストがかからないことがよくありますが、あなたの時間がトレードオフの一部です。

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **負担を分かち合う。** ゲストがそれぞれ料理を持ち寄るポットラック方式のディナーは、コストと作業負荷を分散させます。重複を避けるために、誰が何を持ってきているかを明確にしてください。

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **残り物を計画する。** 七面鳥のサンドイッチ、スープ、キャセロールは、鳥の価値を伸ばします。傷む前に余分なものを冷凍してください。

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **メニューをシンプルにする。** うまく作られた2つまたは3つのサイドは、中途半端に作られた8つよりも満足できることがあります。料理を1つか2つカットすることは、多くの場合、節約する最も簡単な方法です。

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## 現実的な予算の考え方

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: 買い物をする前に目標を設定し、進めながら支出を追跡するのに役立ちます。

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: 多くの買い物客は、書かれたリスト、しっかりした予算、そして価格が高いときに材料をスワップする意欲が、合計をコントロール下に保つことに気づいています。

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: 七面鳥が高価である場合、小さな鳥または七面鳥の胸肉で十分かもしれません。

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: 生鮮品が高価である場合、冷凍または缶詰のバージョンがギャップを埋めることができます。

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: また、休日が何についてのものであるかを思い出すことも価値があります。

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: 食事が記憶に残るために手の込んだものである必要はありません。

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: 会社といくつかのよく作られた料理に焦点を当てるホストは、多くの場合、その日がうまくいくことに気づき、請求額は飲み込みやすくなります。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## ボトムライン

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: 食料品価格は多くの家庭にとって懸念事項であり、ホリデーディナーのコストは、農場の状況から貿易政策、ディーゼルの価格に至るまで、すべてを反映しています。

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: それらの力をコントロールすることはできませんが、どのように計画し、買い物し、料理するかをコントロールすることはできます。

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: 明確なメニュー、ちょっとした比較買い物、そして残り物の賢い利用により、請求額にその日を乗っ取られることなく、満足のいく感謝祭の食事をテーブルに並べることができます。

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: 1. **Beginnen Sie mit einer Personenzahl und einem Menü.** Entscheiden Sie, wie viele Leute kommen, und schreiben Sie jedes Gericht auf, bevor Sie einkaufen. Übermäßiger Einkauf ist eine der häufigsten Ursachen für Verschwendung bei Festtagsessen.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 2. **Planen Sie Portionen realistisch.** Eine gängige Faustregel lautet etwa ein bis anderthalb Pfund Truthahn pro Person für einen Vogel mit Knochen, was etwas für Reste übrig lässt. Einen viel größeren Vogel als nötig zu kaufen, erhöht Kosten und Abfall.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 3. **Vergleichen Sie Prospekte und Apps von Geschäften.** Geschäfte rabattieren in den Wochen vor dem Feiertag oft Truthahn, Konserven und Backwaren. Das Überprüfen mehrerer Prospekte und Treueprogramme kann signifikante Unterschiede aufzeigen.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 4. **Kaufen Sie haltbare Vorräte frühzeitig.** Kürbiskonserven, Brühe, Mehl und Zucker können über mehrere Wochen gekauft werden, wenn sie im Angebot sind, wodurch sich die Kosten verteilen.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 5. **Erwägen Sie Handelsmarken.** Für Grundlagen wie Mehl, Zucker, Gemüsekonserven und Brühe sind Handelsmarken oft vergleichbar in der Qualität und billiger als Markenprodukte.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 6. **Wählen Sie Tiefkühl- oder Saisonware.** Tiefgekühlte grüne Bohnen und anderes Gemüse können billiger sein als frische und genauso nahrhaft. Saisonale Artikel wie Kürbis, Kartoffeln und Preiselbeeren sind im Herbst tendenziell ein besserer Wert.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 7. **Machen Sie einige Gerichte von Grund auf selbst.** Hausgemachte Preiselbeersauce, Füllung und Brötchen kosten oft weniger als gekaufte Versionen, obwohl Ihre Zeit Teil des Kompromisses ist.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 8. **Teilen Sie die Last.** Ein Abendessen im Potluck-Stil, bei dem die Gäste jeweils ein Gericht mitbringen, verteilt die Kosten und die Arbeitslast. Sprechen Sie sich klar ab, wer was mitbringt, um Doppelungen zu vermeiden.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 9. **Planen Sie Reste ein.** Truthahnsandwiches, Suppe und Aufläufe strecken den Wert des Vogels. Frieren Sie Reste ein, bevor sie verderben.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 10. **Vereinfachen Sie das Menü.** Zwei oder drei gut zubereitete Beilagen können befriedigender sein als acht halbherzige. Ein oder zwei Gerichte wegzulassen ist oft der einfachste Weg, um zu sparen.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.

segments.tr: Viele Käufer stellen fest, dass eine schriftliche Liste, ein festes Budget und die Bereitschaft, Zutaten auszutauschen, wenn die Preise hoch sind, die Gesamtsumme unter Kontrolle halten.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Wenn frische Artikel teuer sind, können gefrorene oder konservierte Versionen die Lücke füllen.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Es lohnt sich auch daran zu erinnern, worum es bei dem Feiertag geht.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: Ein Essen muss nicht aufwendig sein, um unvergesslich zu sein.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Gastgeber, die sich auf die Gesellschaft und ein paar gut gemachte Gerichte konzentrieren, stellen oft fest, dass der Tag genauso gut verläuft und die Rechnung leichter zu schlucken ist.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: Die Lebensmittelpreise bleiben für viele Haushalte ein Anliegen, und die Kosten für ein Festtagsessen spiegeln alles wider, von den Bedingungen auf dem Bauernhof über die Handelspolitik bis hin zum Dieselpreis.

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.

vi.title: Hóa đơn bàn tiệc Lễ Tạ ơn: Giá thực phẩm có ý nghĩa gì đối với bữa tối ngày lễ năm nay

segments.src: Every November, hosts face the same math problem: how much will it cost to feed everyone at the table?
segments.tr: Mỗi tháng 11, những người chủ nhà phải đối mặt với cùng một bài toán: chi phí để nuôi sống mọi người trên bàn tiệc là bao nhiêu?

segments.src: This year, many are doing that math while grocery prices remain stubbornly higher than they were a few years ago.
segments.tr: Năm nay, nhiều người đang thực hiện phép tính đó trong khi giá tạp hóa vẫn cao hơn một cách cứng đầu so với vài năm trước.

segments.src: Inflation has cooled from its peak, but cooling is not the same as falling.
segments.tr: Lạm phát đã hạ nhiệt so với mức đỉnh, nhưng hạ nhiệt không có nghĩa là giảm xuống.

segments.src: Most food prices have settled at a higher level, and shoppers still feel it at the register.
segments.tr: Hầu hết giá thực phẩm đã ổn định ở mức cao hơn, và người mua hàng vẫn cảm nhận được điều đó tại quầy thanh toán.

segments.src: This guide explains where the money tends to go, why some items cost more than others, and how to trim the bill without sacrificing the meal.
segments.tr: Hướng dẫn này giải thích tiền thường đi về đâu, tại sao một số mặt hàng đắt hơn những mặt hàng khác và cách cắt giảm hóa đơn mà không làm hy sinh bữa ăn.

segments.src: Figures for any given store or region will vary, so treat this as a framework for planning rather than a price quote.
segments.tr: Số liệu cho bất kỳ cửa hàng hoặc khu vực nào cho trước sẽ khác nhau, vì vậy hãy coi đây là một khung để lập kế hoạch hơn là một báo giá.

segments.src: ## Where the Money Goes
segments.tr: ## Tiền đi về đâu

segments.src: A traditional Thanksgiving dinner is built from a handful of categories.
segments.tr: Một bữa tối Lễ Tạ ơn truyền thống được xây dựng từ một số ít danh mục.

segments.src: Some of them make up most of the total.
segments.tr: Một số trong số đó chiếm phần lớn tổng số.

segments.src: - **The main course.** Turkey is usually the single biggest line item, especially for large gatherings. Prices depend on size, brand, and whether the bird is fresh, frozen, organic, or pasture-raised.
segments.tr: - **Món chính.** Gà tây thường là khoản mục lớn nhất duy nhất, đặc biệt đối với các buổi sum họp lớn. Giá cả phụ thuộc vào kích thước, thương hiệu và liệu con gà là tươi, đông lạnh, hữu cơ hay nuôi thả.

segments.src: - **Dairy and baking staples.** Butter, cream, eggs, and milk show up in nearly every side dish and dessert. Butter and eggs in particular have been known to swing sharply in price.
segments.tr: - **Sản phẩm từ sữa và nguyên liệu làm bánh cơ bản.** Bơ, kem, trứng và sữa xuất hiện trong hầu hết mọi món ăn kèm và món tráng miệng. Đặc biệt bơ và trứng nổi tiếng là có giá dao động mạnh.

segments.src: - **Produce.** Potatoes, sweet potatoes, green beans, cranberries, onions, and celery are individually inexpensive, but they add up when you cook for a crowd.
segments.tr: - **Sản phẩm nông sản.** Khoai tây, khoai lang, đậu đũa, nam việt quất, hành tây và cần tây có giá rẻ khi mua riêng lẻ, nhưng chúng sẽ cộng dồn khi bạn nấu ăn cho một đám đông.

segments.src: - **Pantry basics.** Flour, sugar, stuffing mix, canned pumpkin, broth, and spices are easy to overlook until you are standing in the aisle with a full cart.
segments.tr: - **Nơi trữ thực phẩm cơ bản.** Bột mì, đường, hỗn hợp nhồi, bí ngô đóng hộp, nước dùng và gia vị rất dễ bị bỏ qua cho đến khi bạn đứng ở lối đi với một chiếc xe đẩy đầy.

segments.src: - **Beverages and extras.** Rolls, drinks, and appetizers can quietly push the total higher than expected.
segments.tr: - **Đồ uống và các món phụ.** Bánh mì cuộn, đồ uống và món khai vị có thể lặng lẽ đẩy tổng số tiền lên cao hơn dự kiến.

segments.src: ## Why Turkey Prices Can Jump
segments.tr: ## Tại sao giá gà tây có thể tăng vọt

segments.src: Turkey costs are shaped by factors that sit far upstream of the grocery store.
segments.tr: Chi phí gà tây được định hình bởi các yếu tố nằm xa phía trước cửa hàng tạp hóa.

segments.src: Animal disease outbreaks can shrink flocks and tighten supply.
segments.tr: Các đợt bùng phát dịch bệnh ở động vật có thể làm thu hẹp đàn và thắt chặt nguồn cung.

segments.src: Feed costs, labor, and processing expenses all feed into the wholesale price.
segments.tr: Chi phí thức ăn chăn nuôi, nhân công và chi phí chế biến đều đổ vào giá bán buôn.

segments.src: Retailers also use turkeys as a "loss leader" in the weeks before the holiday, discounting them to draw shoppers into the store and making up the difference on other items.
segments.tr: Các nhà bán lẻ cũng sử dụng gà tây như một "mặt hàng bán lỗ để thu hút khách" trong những tuần trước ngày lễ, giảm giá chúng để thu hút người mua sắm vào cửa hàng và bù đắp chênh lệch ở các mặt hàng khác.

segments.src: That is why the price per pound can vary widely from one store to the next, even in the same town.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao giá trên một pound có thể thay đổi rộng rãi từ cửa hàng này sang cửa hàng khác, ngay cả trong cùng một thị trấn.

segments.src: ## How Tariffs and Fuel Costs Reach the Checkout Line
segments.tr: ## Thuế quan và chi phí nhiên liệu tác động đến quầy thanh toán như thế nào

segments.src: Prices on the shelf include more than the cost of the food itself.
segments.tr: Giá trên kệ bao gồm nhiều thứ hơn là chi phí của chính thực phẩm đó.

segments.src: They reflect the cost of getting that food to you.
segments.tr: Chúng phản ánh chi phí đưa thực phẩm đó đến tay bạn.

segments.src: **Tariffs.** Many pantry items are imported, including some spices, coffee, cocoa, certain fruits and vegetables, and canned goods.
segments.tr: **Thuế quan.** Nhiều mặt hàng trong kho được nhập khẩu, bao gồm một số gia vị, cà phê, ca cao, một số loại trái cây và rau quả, và hàng đóng hộp.

segments.src: When import taxes rise, importers and retailers often pass at least part of the cost along to shoppers.
segments.tr: Khi thuế nhập khẩu tăng, các nhà nhập khẩu và nhà bán lẻ thường chuyển ít nhất một phần chi phí sang người mua hàng.

segments.src: The effect is usually gradual and uneven.
segments.tr: Hiệu ứng thường diễn ra từ từ và không đồng đều.

segments.src: A tariff on one product category may show up as a small increase on dozens of items, rather than one dramatic price jump.
segments.tr: Thuế quan đối với một danh mục sản phẩm có thể xuất hiện dưới dạng mức tăng nhỏ trên hàng dozen mặt hàng, thay vì một lần tăng giá kịch tính.

segments.src: **Fuel and transportation.** Food travels by truck, rail, ship, and plane.
segments.tr: **Nhiل liệu và vận chuyển.** Thực phẩm di chuyển bằng xe tải, tàu hỏa, tàu thủy và máy bay.

segments.src: When diesel and fuel prices rise, shipping gets more expensive, and that cost is built into the price of everything from fresh produce to frozen goods.
segments.tr: Khi giá dầu diesel và nhiên liệu tăng, việc vận chuyển trở nên đắt đỏ hơn, và chi phí đó được tích hợp vào giá của mọi thứ từ nông sản tươi sống đến hàng đông lạnh.

segments.src: Refrigerated transport is especially energy-intensive, which is one reason perishable items can feel the pinch more than shelf-stable ones.
segments.tr: Vận chuyển lạnh đặc biệt tốn nhiều năng lượng, đó là một lý do khiến các mặt hàng dễ hỏng có thể cảm nhận áp lực lớn hơn so với các mặt hàng để được lâu.

segments.src: **Labor, packaging, and energy.** Farms, processing plants, and stores all face higher operating costs.
segments.tr: **Nhân công, bao bì và năng lượng.** Các trang trại, nhà máy chế biến và cửa hàng đều phải đối mặt với chi phí vận hành cao hơn.

segments.src: Packaging materials and electricity for refrigeration are part of that picture.
segments.tr: Vật liệu đóng gói và điện cho việc làm lạnh là một phần của bức tranh đó.

segments.src: These expenses rarely make headlines, but they help explain why prices do not fall quickly even when some commodity costs ease.
segments.tr: Những khoản chi phí này hiếm khi lọt vào trang nhất, nhưng chúng giúp giải thích tại sao giá không giảm nhanh chóng ngay cả khi một số chi phí hàng hóa cơ bản giảm xuống.

segments.src: ## Practical Ways to Trim the Bill
segments.tr: ## Các cách thiết thực để cắt giảm hóa đơn

segments.src: You do not need to give up the traditional meal to spend less.
segments.tr: Bạn không cần phải từ bỏ bữa ăn truyền thống để chi tiêu ít hơn.

segments.src: A few planning habits can make a real difference.
segments.tr: Một vài thói quen lập kế hoạch có thể tạo ra sự khác biệt thực sự.

segments.src: 1. **Start with a headcount and a menu.** Decide how many people are coming and write down every dish before you shop. Over-buying is one of the most common sources of waste at holiday meals.
segments.tr: 1. **Bắt đầu với số lượng người và thực đơn.** Quyết định có bao nhiêu người đến và viết ra mọi món ăn trước khi bạn đi mua sắm. Mua thừa là một trong những nguồn lãng phí phổ biến nhất trong các bữa ăn ngày lễ.

segments.src: 2. **Plan portions realistically.** A common rule of thumb is about one to one and a half pounds of turkey per person for a bone-in bird, which leaves some for leftovers. Buying a much larger bird than you need adds cost and waste.
segments.tr: 2. **Lên kế hoạch khẩu phần thực tế.** Quy tắc chung phổ biến là khoảng từ một đến một rưỡi pound gà tây cho mỗi người đối với con gà có xương, để lại một ít cho phần thừa. Mua một con gà lớn hơn nhiều so với bạn cần sẽ làm tăng chi phí và lãng phí.

segments.src: 3. **Compare store flyers and apps.** Stores often discount turkey, canned goods, and baking items in the weeks leading up to the holiday. Checking several flyers and loyalty programs can reveal meaningful differences.
segments.tr: 3. **So sánh tờ rơi và ứng dụng của cửa hàng.** Các cửa hàng thường giảm giá gà tây, hàng đóng hộp và các mặt hàng làm bánh trong những tuần dẫn đến ngày lễ. Kiểm tra một số tờ rơi và chương trình khách hàng thân thiết có thể cho thấy những điểm khác biệt đáng kể.

segments.src: 4. **Buy shelf-stable items early.** Canned pumpkin, broth, flour, and sugar can be picked up over several weeks as they go on sale, spreading out the cost.
segments.tr: 4. **Mua các mặt hàng để được lâu sớm.** Bí ngô đóng hộp, nước dùng, bột mì và đường có thể được mua trong vài tuần khi chúng được giảm giá, trải đều chi phí.

segments.src: 5. **Consider store brands.** For basics such as flour, sugar, canned vegetables, and broth, store brands are often comparable in quality and cheaper than name brands.
segments.tr: 5. **Cân nhắc nhãn hiệu của cửa hàng.** Đối với các mặt hàng cơ bản như bột mì, đường, rau đóng hộp và nước dùng, nhãn hiệu của cửa hàng thường có chất lượng tương đương và rẻ hơn các nhãn hiệu nổi tiếng.

segments.src: 6. **Choose frozen or in-season produce.** Frozen green beans and other vegetables can be cheaper than fresh and just as nutritious. Seasonal items like squash, potatoes, and cranberries tend to be better values in the fall.
segments.tr: 6. **Chọn sản phẩm nông sản đông lạnh hoặc đúng mùa.** Đậu đũa đông lạnh và các loại rau khác có thể rẻ hơn rau tươi và vẫn đầy đủ chất dinh dưỡng. Các mặt hàng theo mùa như bí, khoai tây và nam việt quất có xu hướng có giá trị tốt hơn vào mùa thu.

segments.src: 7. **Make some dishes from scratch.** Homemade cranberry sauce, stuffing, and rolls often cost less than store-bought versions, though your time is part of the trade-off.
segments.tr: 7. **Tự làm một số món từ đầu.** Xốt nam việt quất, nhân nhồi và bánh mì cuộn tự làm thường có chi phí thấp hơn các phiên bản mua ở cửa hàng, mặc dù thời gian của bạn là một phần của sự đánh đổi.

segments.src: 8. **Share the load.** A potluck-style dinner, where guests each bring a dish, spreads the cost and the workload. Be clear about who is bringing what to avoid duplicates.
segments.tr: 8. **Chia sẻ gánh nặng.** Một bữa tối kiểu potluck, nơi mỗi khách mang theo một món ăn, phân chia chi phí và khối lượng công việc. Hãy rõ ràng về việc ai đang mang cái gì để tránh trùng lặp.

segments.src: 9. **Plan for leftovers.** Turkey sandwiches, soup, and casseroles stretch the value of the bird. Freeze extras before they spoil.
segments.tr: 9. **Lên kế hoạch cho phần thừa.** Bánh mì kẹp gà tây, súp và các món hầm kéo dài giá trị của con gà. Đông lạnh các phần thừa trước khi chúng bị hỏng.

segments.src: 10. **Simplify the menu.** Two or three sides done well can be more satisfying than eight done halfway. Cutting a dish or two is often the easiest way to save.
segments.tr: 10. **Đơn giản hóa thực đơn.** Hai hoặc ba món ăn kèm được làm tốt có thể thỏa mãn hơn tám món làm qua loa. Cắt bỏ một hoặc hai món thường là cách dễ nhất để tiết kiệm.

segments.src: ## A Realistic Budget Mindset
segments.tr: ## Tư duy ngân sách thực tế

segments.src: It helps to set a target before you shop and track your spending as you go.
segments.tr: Việc đặt mục tiêu trước khi mua sắm và theo dõi chi tiêu của bạn khi đi là rất hữu ích.

segments.src: Many shoppers find that a written list, a firm budget, and a willingness to swap ingredients when prices are high keep the total under control.
segments.tr: Nhiều người mua sắm thấy rằng một danh sách bằng văn bản, một ngân sách vững chắc và sự sẵn sàng thay thế nguyên liệu khi giá cao giúp kiểm soát tổng chi phí.

segments.src: If the turkey is pricey, a smaller bird or a turkey breast may be enough.
segments.tr: Nếu gà tây đắt đỏ, một con gà nhỏ hơn hoặc ức gà tây có thể là đủ.

segments.src: If fresh items are expensive, frozen or canned versions can fill the gap.
segments.tr: Nếu các mặt hàng tươi sống đắt đỏ, các phiên bản đông lạnh hoặc đóng hộp có thể lấp đầy khoảng trống.

segments.src: It is also worth remembering what the holiday is about.
segments.tr: Cũng đáng nhớ lại kỳ nghỉ này nói về điều gì.

segments.src: A meal does not need to be elaborate to be memorable.
segments.tr: Một bữa ăn không cần phải cầu kỳ để đáng nhớ.

segments.src: Hosts who focus on the company and a few well-made dishes often find that the day goes just as well, and the bill is easier to swallow.
segments.tr: Những chủ nhà tập trung vào công ty và một vài món ăn được làm tốt thường thấy rằng ngày đó diễn ra suôn sẻ và hóa đơn dễ nuốt trôi hơn.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: Grocery prices remain a concern for many households, and the cost of a holiday dinner reflects everything from farm conditions to trade policy to the price of diesel.
segments.tr: Giá hàng tạp hóa vẫn là mối lo ngại đối với nhiều hộ gia đình, và chi phí cho bữa tối ngày lễ phản ánh mọi thứ từ điều kiện trang trại đến chính sách thương mại và giá dầu diesel.

segments.src: You cannot control those forces, but you can control how you plan, shop, and cook.
segments.tr: Bạn không thể kiểm soát các lực lượng đó, nhưng bạn có thể kiểm soát cách bạn lên kế hoạch, mua sắm và nấu nướng.

segments.src: With a clear menu, a bit of comparison shopping, and smart use of leftovers, you can put a satisfying Thanksgiving meal on the table without letting the bill take over the day.
segments.tr: Với một thực đơn rõ ràng, một chút so sánh mua sắm và sử dụng thông minh các phần thừa, bạn có thể đặt một bữa ăn Lễ Tạ ơn thỏa mãn lên bàn mà không để hóa đơn chiếm lấy cả ngày.

segments.src: *This article is for general informational purposes only and is not financial advice.
segments.tr: *Bài viết này chỉ dành cho mục đích thông tin chung và không phải là lời khuyên tài chính.

segments.src: Prices vary by store and region, so check current local prices when planning your purchases.*
segments.tr: Giá cả thay đổi theo cửa hàng và khu vực, vì vậy hãy kiểm tra giá địa phương hiện tại khi lên kế hoạch mua hàng của bạn.*
